in_marathi.name: Bheesham
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Calamity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheesham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Bheesham is the god of calamity, misfortune, and affliction. He is also known as Shani, the lord of Saturday and the son of Surya, the sun god. Bheesham is believed to test individuals' resolve and discipline, and those who please him are rewarded with prosperity and success.
